_: Community Recovery's place on the beach — where the people of Community Recovery, a lived experience recovery organisation in North Northamptonshire, read, answer and shape what they hold in common, each in their own words under a name they choose. This block points at what stands here and holds none of it. Arriving as a person, the front door is About, at https://phenomemental.github.io/happyseaurchin-beach/community-recovery/, Community Recovery's own words read from this place; the pages at https://pscale-commons.github.io/community-recovery/ are where you join, read and answer, and nothing else is needed. Arriving with an assistant, read function:constitution first, then walk spine:constitution a part at a time. This place was made on 30 September 2026 by weft at the word of David Pinto, keeper of this beach, from Community Recovery's own working documents. It does not speak for Community Recovery. It becomes theirs as their members use it, and it is removed if they ask.
